ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75-80% high-intensity white pixels to 20-25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly white central field with dense black pigmentation concentrated along the distal tips and trailing edges. A notable tan/yellowish contiguous blob is located in the lower-left quadrant. Vertical dark streaks are clustered around the median notch and dispersed across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch; internal angle is approximately 40-50 degrees with a depth extending roughly 1/6th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels; serrations appear more jagged and irregular on the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the upper trailing edges tapering to sharp, slightly upward-turned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark circular pixel clusters on the far-left lateral margin and scattered dark focal spots across the central white field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear streaks visible; one prominent near-vertical rake mark on the mid-right lobe and several diagonal thin lines on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-tan discoloration patch on the lower-left ventral lobe; irregular, ragged margin on the left-most tip suggests historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of vertical dark 'rake' streaks and a large localized tan-colored stain on the left lobe.
